accounts_credential_only.name: accounts_credential_only
accounts_credential_only.value:
"accounts"."provider_id" = 'credential' and "accounts"."password" is not null
        and "accounts"."access_token" is null and "accounts"."refresh_token" is null and "accounts"."id_token" is null
        and "accounts"."access_token_expires_at" is null and "accounts"."refresh_token_expires_at" is null
        and "accounts"."scope" is null

memberships_archived_with_reason.name: memberships_archived_with_reason
memberships_archived_with_reason.value:
("memberships"."archived_at" is null) = ("memberships"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("memberships"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("memberships"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

audit_entries_actor.name: audit_entries_actor
audit_entries_actor.value:
("audit_entries"."actor_kind" = 'person' and "audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is not null and "audit_entries"."actor_api_client_id" is null)
        or ("audit_entries"."actor_kind" = 'api_client' and "audit_entries"."actor_api_client_id" is not null and "audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is null)
        or ("audit_entries"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_entries"."actor_api_client_id" is null)

chart_accounts_code_shape.name: chart_accounts_code_shape
chart_accounts_code_shape.value:
("chart_accounts"."level" = 1 and "chart_accounts"."code" ~ '^[1-5]$')
        or ("chart_accounts"."level" = 2 and "chart_accounts"."code" ~ '^[1-5][1-9]$')
        or ("chart_accounts"."level" = 3 and "chart_accounts"."code" ~ '^[1-5][1-9][1-9]$')
        or ("chart_accounts"."level" = 4 and "chart_accounts"."code" ~ '^[1-5][1-9][1-9][0-9]{3}$' and right("chart_accounts"."code", 3) <> '000')

chart_accounts_class_of_code.name: chart_accounts_class_of_code
chart_accounts_class_of_code.value:
("chart_accounts"."class" = case left("chart_accounts"."code", 1) when '1' then 'asset' when '2' then 'liability'
        when '3' then 'equity' when '4' then 'revenue' when '5' then 'expense' end) is true

chart_accounts_statement_line.name: chart_accounts_statement_line
chart_accounts_statement_line.value:
("chart_accounts"."kind" = 'postable') = ("chart_accounts"."statement_line" is not null)
        and ("chart_accounts"."statement_line" is null
          or ("chart_accounts"."class" in ('asset', 'liability', 'equity')
            and "chart_accounts"."statement_line" in ('bs.cash', 'bs.trade_receivables', 'bs.contract_assets', 'bs.other_current_assets', 'bs.ppe', 'bs.trade_payables', 'bs.contract_liabilities', 'bs.client_money', 'bs.tax_liabilities', 'bs.accruals', 'bs.share_capital', 'bs.retained_earnings', 'bs.owner_current'))
          or ("chart_accounts"."class" in ('revenue', 'expense')
            and "chart_accounts"."statement_line" in ('is.revenue', 'is.other_income', 'is.direct_costs', 'is.employee_benefits', 'is.depreciation', 'is.other_expenses', 'is.fx_differences', 'is.finance_costs', 'is.income_tax')))

chart_accounts_flags.name: chart_accounts_flags
chart_accounts_flags.value:
(not ("chart_accounts"."is_control" or "chart_accounts"."is_monetary") or "chart_accounts"."class" in ('asset', 'liability'))
        and ("chart_accounts"."kind" = 'postable' or (not "chart_accounts"."is_control" and not "chart_accounts"."is_monetary" and "chart_accounts"."currency" is null))

chart_accounts_blocked_with_reason.name: chart_accounts_blocked_with_reason
chart_accounts_blocked_with_reason.value:
("chart_accounts"."blocked_at" is null) = ("chart_accounts"."blocked_reason" is null)
        and ("chart_accounts"."blocked_reason" is null or char_length("chart_accounts"."blocked_reason") between 1 and 1000)

chart_accounts_archived_with_reason.name: chart_accounts_archived_with_reason
chart_accounts_archived_with_reason.value:
("chart_accounts"."archived_at" is null) = ("chart_accounts"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("chart_accounts"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("chart_accounts"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

companies_name_latin_length.name: companies_name_latin_length
companies_name_latin_length.value: "companies"."name_latin" is null or char_length("companies"."name_latin") between 1 and 200

companies_archived_with_reason.name: companies_archived_with_reason
companies_archived_with_reason.value:
("companies"."archived_at" is null) = ("companies"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("companies"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("companies"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

company_settings_currencies.name: company_settings_currencies
company_settings_currencies.value:
"company_settings"."book_currency" in ('USD', 'SYP', 'TRY', 'EUR')
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_currency" is null or "company_settings"."parallel_currency" in ('USD', 'SYP', 'TRY', 'EUR'))

company_settings_rate_types.name: company_settings_rate_types
company_settings_rate_types.value:
"company_settings"."book_rate_type" in ('market', 'bulletin')
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" is null or "company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" in ('market', 'bulletin'))

company_settings_parallel_complete.name: company_settings_parallel_complete
company_settings_parallel_complete.value:
("company_settings"."parallel_currency" is null) = ("company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" is null)
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_currency" is null) = ("company_settings"."parallel_accepts_transaction_rate" is null)

company_settings_transaction_rate_market.name: company_settings_transaction_rate_market_only
company_settings_transaction_rate_market.value:
(not "company_settings"."book_accepts_transaction_rate" or "company_settings"."book_rate_type" = 'market')
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_accepts_transaction_rate" is not true or "company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" = 'market')

dimension_values_code_length.name: dimension_values_code_length
dimension_values_code_length.value: "dimension_values"."code" is null or char_length("dimension_values"."code") between 1 and 40

dimension_values_external.name: dimension_values_external
dimension_values_external.value:
("dimension_values"."external_source" is null) = ("dimension_values"."external_id" is null)
        and ("dimension_values"."external_source" is null or "dimension_values"."external_source" in ('hub'))
        and ("dimension_values"."external_id" is null or char_length("dimension_values"."external_id") between 1 and 100)

exchange_rates_correction_reason.name: exchange_rates_correction_reason
exchange_rates_correction_reason.value:
("exchange_rates"."supersedes_rate_id" is null) = ("exchange_rates"."reason" is null)
        and ("exchange_rates"."reason" is null or char_length("exchange_rates"."reason") between 1 and 500)
